method_change_sensitivity_note: 2021-2025 has ten post-August-2010 training targets per month. January-March 2011 training rows still have prior-year gas features from the earlier methodology; this is not a claim that every training input is post-change. The predeclared sample is unchanged.

protocol.mechanism: Colder lower-troposphere USA48 satellite temperatures proxy surface cold, driving residential space-heating natural gas demand; economic target is reported later.
protocol.predictor: UAH version 6.1 lower-troposphere USA48 monthly temperature anomaly, satellite MSU/AMSU record
protocol.outcome: EIA monthly U.S. natural gas delivered to residential consumers, million cubic feet, divided by days in month to reduce month-length artefacts
protocol.season: October through March only; calendar target months January 2000 through December 2025 inclusive
protocol.forecast_issue: 15th day of month immediately after target month, a delayed-release economic nowcast, not a future-weather forecast
protocol.availability: UAH and ground HDD assumed available by month-end plus14days. EIA labels assumed available at end of second month after target month. Both current archives, not historical release-vintage proof.

models.baseline: Separate calendar-month OLS: intercept, linear year trend centered at target year, previous-year same-month residential gas/day
models.satellite: Identical baseline plus current-month UAH USA48 anomaly
models.ground_hdd: Identical baseline plus current-month official national ground heating degree days/day
models.ground_hdd_satellite: Identical ground-HDD model plus current-month UAH USA48 anomaly

protocol.training: Exactly previous 10 years of the same calendar month, all labels before issue; missing required source/target/prior gas abstains; no future targets, no tuning or clipping
protocol.evaluation: RMSE and MAE on identical complete months; evaluate direct satellite vs baseline and incremental combined vs ground-HDD
protocol.uncertainty: Paired circular two-winter-year block bootstrap,10000draws,seed20260927. Winteryear=y+1 forOct-Dec else y; boundarywinters mayhave3months; samplewholewinterblocks.
protocol.gate: At least5% RMSE reduction, lowerMAE, and strictlypositive95%RMSE-reductioninterval forboth satellite vsbaseline AND ground_hdd_satellite vsground_hdd. MissingHDD meansnoincrementalusefulnessverification.
protocol.planned_sensitivity: Separately summarize calendar2021-2025, when all10 trainingyears followAug2010 EIAcollectionchange; descriptiveonly, noselection or newgate.
claim_limits: Current-vintage rolling retrospective nowcast; nohistoricalpoint-in-time certification
UAH islayer temperature, notsurface orstation heatingdegree days

source_urls.ground_hdd: Official NOAA/CPC or EIA-sourced national ground HDD, retrieval by independent agent; source selection based on availability not outcomes

units: Billion cubic feet per day (EIA MMcf divided by 1000 and calendar days)
interpretation: Contemporaneous winter gas-demand nowcast ahead of assumed EIA publication; all predictors and labels are revised current archives. Ground HDD is a required comparator. No market alpha or actual historical-release reconstruction.
